# Bedrock Roof

> Bedrock Roof is a free referral service that connects homeowners anywhere in the United States with independent local roofing contractors for a free roof inspection and written quote. It is free for homeowners; contractors may pay for introductions. Bedrock Roof is not a roofing contractor and does not perform or warranty roofing work.

Homeowners can request a free quote at https://bedrockroof.com/get-quotes/ for roof replacement, roof repair or leaks, storm damage, or a roof inspection.

## Guides
- [How much does a roof replacement cost?](https://bedrockroof.com/roof-replacement-cost/): National price ranges and how to compare quotes.
- [How to choose a roofer you can trust](https://bedrockroof.com/choosing-a-roofer/): License, insurance, warranties and red flags.
- [What to do after storm damage](https://bedrockroof.com/storm-damage/): Safety, photos, insurance and storm chasers.
- [How to tell if hail damaged your roof](https://bedrockroof.com/hail-damage-roof/): Signs to look for and what to do next.
- [Roof leaking? What to do right now](https://bedrockroof.com/roof-leak/): Limit the damage and find the cause.
- [Does insurance cover roof replacement?](https://bedrockroof.com/insurance-roof-replacement/): What's usually covered and how claims work.
- [9 signs you might need a new roof](https://bedrockroof.com/signs-you-need-a-new-roof/): What roofers look for.
- [How long does a roof last?](https://bedrockroof.com/how-long-does-a-roof-last/): Lifespan by material.
- [Should you repair or replace your roof?](https://bedrockroof.com/roof-repair-or-replace/): How to decide.
